groups.label: Streaming and content core
groups.purpose: Direct-to-consumer streaming, content spending, libraries, international expansion and streaming profitability

operational_references.reason: Global subscription, pricing, churn and engagement reference, but music-royalty economics differ and the current SEC pipeline does not support its foreign-issuer filing regime.
YouTube is a major attention competitor, but Alphabet is advertising-led and is not a direct Netflix valuation peer.
Consumer-attention and advertising-quality reference; not a subscription-content valuation peer.
Prime Video is an important bundled-content competitor, but AWS and retail make Amazon's consolidated multiple unsuitable for Netflix medians.
Connected-TV advertising and distribution reference; its economics differ from Netflix's subscription-content model.

review.rationale: Netflix has no clean public comparable. DIS, WBD and PSKY form the narrow content-and-streaming core; subscription quality, attention competition, advertising optionality and bundled content remain separate non-median references.
